newsitem.title: USA: MFS Comms unit forms Web services unit.
newsitem.headline: MFS Comms unit forms Web services unit.

text.p: UUNET Technologies, a unit of MFS Communications Co Inc, said on Tuesday it had created a new business unit focused on Web server hosting and related opportunities.
The new organization, known as the Web Services Business Unit, is comprised of sales, marketing and technical resources for the company to manage websites for corporate customers, UUNET said.
UUNET said security risks to a customer's network can increase if the customer manages its own website.
